guidetextdraw_copy_c.text: 2021 SUMMER LOAN REQUEST FOR CONTINUING STUDENTS

panel.jcr:title: Form Section
panel.name: formContainer

guidetextdraw_1404623293._value: Select situation below which is relevant to you and attach a copy of documentation showing that you have resolved your loan status:
guidetextdraw_1404623293.name: textdraw_14046232931657629827718

guidetextdraw_1010121353._value: Defaulted Loans - If one or more of your federal student loans are defaulted, submit this form only after you can attach documentation that the loans are repaid or rehabilitated
guidetextdraw_1010121353.name: textdraw_10101213531657630101233

guidetextdraw_101012._value: Active Bankruptcy Claim - If you have a non-defaulted student loan in an active bankruptcy claim, you will most likely be eligible for aid as long as you do not have any student loans in a default status. Attach your NSLDS loan history to this form to document that all your student loans are in good standing
guidetextdraw_101012.name: textdraw_10101213531657630101233_copy_1

guidetextdraw_101012_544471750._value: Non-Veteran Disability Discharge - If you wish to take out additional student loans, attach a physician’s certification that you have the ability to engage in substantial gainful activity AND a statement that you signed stating that you are aware the new student loans can’t later be discharged for any present impairment unless your condition deteriorates to the point where you become permanently disabled.
guidetextdraw_101012_544471750.name: textdraw_10101213531657630101233_copy_2

guidetextdraw_101012_159407712._value: • If you do not meet the three year conditional disability discharge, you must also include a signed statement that you affirm you will resume responsibility to pay back your previous student loans.
guidetextdraw_101012_159407712.name: textdraw_10101213531657630101233_copy_4

guidetextdraw_101012_22907722._value: Veteran Disability Discharge - If you qualified for a disability discharge based on one of the two standards listed below, submit a copy of the documentation that confirms your eligibility:
guidetextdraw_101012_22907722.name: textdraw_10101213531657630101233_copy_3

guidetextdraw_101012_1904982004._value:
• Letter from the VA confirming that you have a service connected 100 % disability; OR
  • Letter from the VA confirming that you are totally disabled based on your employability determination; AND
  • A physician’s certification that you have the ability to engage in substantial gainful activity; AND
  • A statement that you signed stating that you are aware the new student loans or TEACH Grant service obligation can’t later be discharged for any present impairment unless your condition deteriorates to the point where you become permanently disabled.
guidetextdraw_101012_1904982004.name: textdraw_10101213531657630101233_copy_5

guidetextdraw_609773._value:
INSTRUCTIONS:

When you filed your Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA), the FAFSA processor sent you a response indicating their records showed that a previous loan is in default, discharged, or that you have filed bankruptcy. Based on that response, the federal government requires that we obtain information from you to confirm your continued eligibility to receive federal funds. Incomplete documents will not be returned. They will be disposed of in a secure manner, per university policy. This will delay processing.
guidetextdraw_609773.name: textdraw_6097737761646304849565

guidetextbox.jcr:title: Text Box
guidetextbox._value: Your loan history from the National Student Loan Data System (www.nsldsfap.ed.gov) may show that your loans are defaulted. You may call the U.S. Department of Education at 1.800.621.3115 for assistance or for information regarding your loan.
guidetextbox.name: textbox1662381403228

guidetextdraw._value: We cannot proceed with the review of your financial aid eligibility until you submit a copy of the requested documentation that is appropriate to you situation and it is verified as resolved.
guidetextdraw.name: textdraw1657101385850

guidetextdraw._value:
Please Note:

  • Attachment does not support following special characters / \\ : * ? & { } ; [ ]
  • Only PDF files are allowed!
  • At least one supporting document is required.
guidetextdraw.name: supDocErrorMessage

guidetextdraw_copy_c_1156861149._value: Warning: If you give false or misleading information on documents submitted to the Office of Financial Aid, you may be fined, be sentenced to jail or both.
guidetextdraw_copy_c_1156861149.name: textdraw1609735280988_copy_2

guidetextdraw._value: By signing this form, I (we) certify that all of the information reported on this form and any attachments hereto is true, complete and accurate. I (we) agree to provide additional proof of the information I (we) have reported, if requested to do so. I (we) also certify that I (we) have read the terms and conditions section of the CSU Fullerton, Financial Aid website (http://www.fullerton.edu/financialaid/info/Terms.php)
guidetextdraw.name: textdraw1660913786259
